hypothesis_and_implications.why_the_md_json_discrepancy_existed: research_entity/trigger_runs/2/*/FINAL_REPORT.md files are point-in-time audit snapshots, not live views -- they are never automatically re-synced when a later JSON receipt closes a row they described as open. This is not a bug in either artifact; it is a structural property of frozen markdown reports that this addendum-per-run-id convention (already established elsewhere in this repo, e.g. the a02-test-contract-repair run) exists specifically to reconcile.
hypothesis_and_implications.implication: Any future reader of a trigger_runs/*/FINAL_REPORT.md should check for a sibling REENTRY_ADDENDUM.json (or a later one in a different run_id directory, cross-referenced via main_observed_before_addendum) before treating its table as current -- this addendum is exactly that pointer for the 2355-vps-reentry-audit report.
